top_signals.title: HSBC Moves to Wall Street Bonus Model
top_signals.summary: HSBC will phase out fixed-pay allowances for its senior staff and instead hand out a greater proportion of its compensation in the form of bonuses, becoming the latest UK lender to switch to Wall Street-style remuneration to better align with performance.
